patch.value: Preflight override declared no static command ownership, so the host ran it on every command

The extension registered its preflight override as a bare callback and scoped itself at runtime with an early return when ctx.command was not todos import.

That guard scopes the WORK but not the REGISTRATION. The SDK exposes ScopedPreflightOverrideDefinition precisely so ownership can be declared statically, and the host uses that declaration to decide whether to invoke the override at all. With no declaration the override is owned by every command, so pm invoked it on every single command and only the callback body prevented it from doing anything.

Fix: register the object form with commands set to todos import, and drop the now-unreachable runtime guard.

Verified with a full installation of 15 published fleet extensions in one project. Note the fix does NOT clear the pm health extension_preflight_override_collision warnings: the collision check does not consult declared ownership, so it reports a pairwise clique over every extension that registers a preflight regardless of scope. That is an upstream defect, filed as unbraind/pm-cli#971, and it is the reason this change is justified on dispatch-correctness grounds alone rather than on the warning count.

Registered the preflight through ScopedPreflightOverrideDefinition with commands set to todos import and removed the now-unreachable runtime command guard. Added a smoke test asserting the exact declared ownership array; verified it FAILS when the registration is reverted to the bare-callback form and passes with the fix. Full suite 138 pass 0 fail; coverage gate met at 69.53 lines 85.44 branches 74.29 functions.
